cases.uiLocation: LoginPage — Card, heading, fields, Sign in button
cases.title: Login page loads with all primary controls
cases.what: User opens the tenant login URL and sees the sign-in card with username, password, and submit controls.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to /login on the tenant host.
2. Wait for #login-username.
3. Verify heading, fields, Sign in, and Forgot Password link.
validationPoints: Heading shows Sign in to Dyly
cases.expected: Login page renders completely without errors.

cases.title: Username field has correct accessibility attributes
cases.what: The email/username field exposes required and autocomplete attributes for accessible sign-in.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Inspect #login-username attributes and label.
cases.expected: Username field is properly labeled and marked required.

cases.title: Password field is masked by default
cases.what: The password input is type password until the user toggles visibility.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Inspect #login-password type attribute.
cases.expected: Password is masked by default.

cases.title: Forgot Password link targets control plane
cases.what: The forgot-password link points at the Super Admin control-plane URL.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Read href on Forgot Password link.
cases.expected: Forgot Password href is configured for control-plane reset flow.

cases.title: Submit with empty username shows validation error
cases.what: Client-side validation blocks sign-in when the username field is empty.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Leave username empty.
3. Enter any password.
4. Click Sign in.
cases.expected: User sees username required error and remains on login page.

cases.title: Submit with empty password shows validation error
cases.what: Client-side validation blocks sign-in when the password field is empty.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter username.
3. Leave password empty.
4. Click Sign in.
cases.expected: User sees password required error and remains on login page.

cases.title: Submit with both fields empty shows username error first
cases.what: Empty form submission surfaces the username validation message first.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Click Sign in without entering credentials.
cases.expected: Username required error is shown.

cases.title: Valid email credentials sign in successfully
cases.what: A licensed user signs in with valid tenant email credentials and leaves the login page.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter E2E_ERP_USERNAME and E2E_ERP_PASSWORD.
3. Click Sign in.
validationPoints: App shell or home content visible
cases.expected: User is authenticated and navigated away from login.

cases.title: Sign in button shows loading state while submitting
cases.what: During authentication the submit button is disabled and shows a loading indicator.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter valid credentials.
3. Click Sign in and observe button state before navigation.
cases.expected: Submit shows in-progress state before success navigation.

cases.title: Session persists after page reload
cases.what: After a successful login, reloading the page does not return the user to the login screen.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in with valid credentials.
2. Reload the page.
3. Verify URL is not /login.
cases.expected: Authenticated session survives reload.

cases.title: Trimmed username with surrounding spaces signs in
cases.what: Leading and trailing spaces on the username are trimmed before authentication.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter username with leading/trailing spaces.
3. Enter valid password.
4. Sign in.
cases.expected: Trimmed username authenticates successfully.

cases.title: Valid email login succeeds after phone-number failure
cases.what: After a failed phone-number attempt, valid email credentials still authenticate.
cases.steps:
1. Fail login with unregistered phone.
2. Clear and enter valid email credentials.
3. Sign in.
cases.expected: Email login works after a phone-number rejection.

cases.title: Wrong password shows authentication error
cases.what: Invalid password for a known username shows a credentials error with admin guidance.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter valid username and wrong password.
3. Click Sign in.
cases.expected: Authentication is rejected with a clear error message.

cases.workflowStep: Fail then retry with valid password
cases.title: Error clears on successful retry after failed login
cases.what: A previous error message is cleared when the user submits valid credentials.
cases.steps:
1. Trigger wrong-password error.
2. Enter correct password.
3. Sign in again.
cases.expected: User can recover from a failed attempt and sign in.

cases.title: Toggle show and hide password
cases.what: The eye control switches the password field between masked and visible text.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter password.
3. Click show password.
4. Click hide password.
validationPoints: type changes to text then password
cases.expected: Password visibility toggles correctly.

cases.title: Form fields disabled while submitting
cases.what: Username, password, and submit controls are disabled during an in-flight login request.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter valid credentials.
3. Click Sign in and assert disabled state during request.
cases.expected: Inputs are disabled while login is in progress.

cases.title: Unauthenticated user is redirected to login
cases.what: A guest who opens a protected module URL is sent to the login page.
cases.steps:
1. Without auth storage, open /thinkspace/task.
2. Wait for navigation.
cases.expected: Guest is redirected to login.

cases.title: Deep link preserved after login
cases.what: After signing in from a protected-route redirect, the user lands on the originally requested path.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task as guest.
2. Sign in on login page.
3. Verify landing URL.
cases.expected: User returns to the deep-linked module after login.

cases.title: MUST REJECT login — unregistered phone number in username field
cases.what: A 10-digit mobile number not provisioned as an ERP login is rejected with invalid-credentials messaging.
cases.steps:
1. Open tenant /login.
2. Enter 9668123855.
3. Enter any password.
4. Click Sign in.
validationPoints: Alert contains No active account found with the given credentials
cases.expected: Login is rejected; user remains on login page.

cases.title: Unregistered 9-series mobile login fails
cases.what: Another valid-format but unregistered mobile number is rejected.
cases.steps:
1. Enter 9876543210 and any password.
2. Sign in.
cases.expected: Login fails for unregistered mobile.

cases.workflowStep: Unregistered phone with valid ERP password
cases.title: Unregistered phone with valid ERP password still fails
cases.what: Using the automation user's real password with an unregistered phone number still fails.
cases.steps:
1. Enter 9668123855.
2. Enter E2E_ERP_PASSWORD.
3. Sign in.
validationPoints: Failure is due to unknown user
cases.expected: Login rejected because phone is not a registered login.

cases.title: Short numeric username fails
cases.what: A numeric username shorter than 10 digits is rejected.
cases.steps:
1. Enter 966812 and any password.
2. Sign in.
cases.expected: Short numeric login is rejected.

cases.title: Email login works after phone-number failure
cases.what: User can recover from phone login failure and sign in with email.
cases.steps:
1. Fail with phone number.
2. Enter valid email credentials.
3. Sign in.
cases.expected: Email path works after phone rejection.

cases.title: Mobile number shows inline username validation on blur
cases.what: When the user enters a mobile number and moves to the password field, an inline error appears under Email or username before Sign in.
cases.steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Type 9668123855 in username.
3. Tab/focus to password.
4. Verify #login-username-error is visible.
cases.expected: Field-level validation blocks mobile username before submit.

cases.uiLocation: LoginPage — field error, no auth/token API call
cases.title: Sign in with mobile username does not call auth API
cases.what: Submitting with a mobile-only username stays on field validation and does not POST /auth/token/.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mobile in username.
2. Enter password.
3. Click Sign in.
4. Assert zero token API requests.
cases.expected: Client validation prevents server login attempt.

cases.workflowStep: Mobile + valid ERP password → Sign in
cases.title: Valid ERP password does not bypass mobile username validation
cases.what: Even with the correct ERP password, a mobile-only username is rejected at the field.
cases.steps:
1. Enter 9668123855.
2. Blur to password.
3. Enter E2E_ERP_PASSWORD.
4. Sign in.
cases.expected: Password cannot bypass mobile username field validation.

cases.workflowStep: Mobile error → clear → valid email blur
cases.title: Field error clears when user replaces mobile with email
cases.what: After a mobile validation error, entering a valid email clears the inline username error on blur.
cases.steps:
1. Trigger mobile field error.
2. Clear and enter email.
3. Blur to password.
4. Verify error hidden.
cases.expected: Valid email identifier clears field validation.
